content: 2026-06-30 Phase A + B 进展。Phase A 已全部写入磁盘并 tsc 通过：(1) globals.css 加 100dvh/safe-area-inset/range-input美化 (2) chatStore.ts zustand+persist 75行 (3) layout.tsx PWA/viewport-fit-cover/apple-web-app (4) ChatSettings.tsx 191行设置抽屉(model选择/system prompt/context滑块/thinking budget/prompt caching开关/清空对话) (5) ChatView.tsx 295行(用chatStore/显示token统计/cache badge/auto-grow textarea/enterKeyHint) (6) api/chat/route.ts 110行(prompt caching: system+history breakpoint上cache_control/thinking budget可调/返回usage)。Phase B 方案确认为 Zeabur Postgres + Prisma。npm install prisma @prisma/client 跑了但 shell 随后变静默（stdout pipe 可能被 npm 子进程挤死）。下次接续：确认 prisma 装好、写 schema.prisma(ChatSession/ChatMessage/ChatConfig)、prisma migrate、写 /api/chat/sync route、ChatStore 加 server sync hook。
